---
title: "The Name Chloe Over Time"
format: html
---

This plot shows the number of babies named Chloe in each year, split by sex.
Run `python download.py` first to create the data file used below.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

names <- read_csv("ssa-baby-names.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

chloe <- names |>
  filter(name == "Chloe") |>
  mutate(sex = recode(sex, F = "Female", M = "Male"))

ggplot(chloe, aes(x = year, y = count, color = sex)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of babies",
    color = "Sex"
  )
```
